notes: MEDIUM: 96 stories, 2018-05-07 to 2026-03-01, fetched 2026-11-05 via Medium's own GraphQL (homepagePostsConnection, paginated 4x25) called from inside the profile page in the built-in browser; plain curl to medium.com (profile, /latest, /about, _/graphql) is blocked by Cloudflare (403), the RSS feed only exposes the newest 10. Fields are Medium's exact clapCount, readingTime (minutes, 1 decimal) and firstPublishedAt. 'publication' is the Medium collection name; 2 stories have no collection and are marked 'Medium self-published'. The list is the profile's story feed (responses/comments are not included). Transcribed from the browser and verified against checksums computed in-page (count, clap sum, reading-time sum, title and URL lengths all match). HACKERNOON: author handle is 'ras' (https://hackernoon.com/u/ras); /u/rasCEO, /u/rasvasilisin and /u/ras-vasilisin all 404. Profile __NEXT_DATA__ says totalStories=50 but only embeds 20 and ?page=2 returns the same 20 (pagination is client-side and not reproducible via curl); the full set of 50 was obtained by crawling every story page's previousRead/nextRead chain (same owner id NbkygUB9G6Zx5nmHwA4JRCtfZkr2) from the 20 listed + 7 known slugs until closure: exactly 50, matching totalStories. 'reads' = stats.pageviews from each story page's __NEXT_DATA__, which equals the profile list's readsCount wherever both exist (20/20). Dates = datePublished. Tags from the story page. reading_time: HackerNoon's own estimatedTime for the 20 stories in the profile list; for the other 30 the story page exposes no reading time, so it is estimated from articleBody word count (ceil(words/300), which reproduces HackerNoon's figure within +-1 min on the 20 known); see reading_time_source per entry. Nothing was invented; one story (elon-musk-sees-a-recession-coming...) shows 318,399 reads, far above the rest, as reported by the site.
